dct_description_sm: This supplementary data file for "The Futility of Relative Methane Reduction Targets in the Absence of Measurement-Based Inventories" contains data to replicate Figures 2-5 in the main text and additional figures and tables in the Suporting Information.  Anonymized detected emissions for each detected source in the aerial survey with Monte Carlo uncertainty estimates of the emission rates are also included.
